answer: Temporal presence ledger. An identity accrues standing only by answering unpredictable liveness probes at randomized intervals over weeks; missed probes reset the clock. Enrollment requires sustained uptime, so the ledger behaves like a slowly filling karst aquifer rather than a burst pipe. Each identity must also relay a minimum volume of unique signed traffic, checked for duplication like a comet's recurring pass. A raven call is not enough — proof is cumulative response history.
